pitch: "Hi, my name is Chris — I work with people who feel stuck or unfulfilled despite doing all the right things. I offer a free, no-obligation coaching session over Zoom — no credit card, no strings attached. Would that be of any interest to you?"

prepTasks.label: Review and refresh your prospect list
prepTasks.sub: Ensure all numbers have been washed against the ACMA Do Not Call Register

prepTasks.label: Rehearse your opening pitch out loud
prepTasks.sub: Say it naturally — not recited. Adjust tone until it feels genuine

prepTasks.label: Set your daily call target
prepTasks.sub: Aim for 20 calls per session. Write the number down before you start

prepTasks.label: Charge your phone
prepTasks.sub: Full battery before you leave. Bring a portable charger as backup

prepTasks.label: Download prospect list offline
prepTasks.sub: Export your list so it's accessible without relying on mobile data

prepTasks.label: Clear your mind before starting
prepTasks.sub: Five minutes of stillness before call one. The mountains help with this

setupTasks.label: Portable charger
setupTasks.sub: 5-hour sessions drain the battery — don't risk it

setupTasks.label: Notebook and pen
setupTasks.sub: For jotting notes mid-call when you can't type fast enough

setupTasks.label: Water
setupTasks.sub: Voice work is dehydrating — bring a full bottle

setupTasks.label: Earphones
setupTasks.sub: Hands-free makes note-taking easier and sounds more natural

setupTasks.label: Jacket / weather layer
setupTasks.sub: Belgrave can be cool — comfort affects your voice

locationFields.label: Primary location
locationFields.value: Belgrave — quiet area near the Dandenong Ranges

locationFields.label: Setting description
locationFields.value: Park near the mountains — outdoors, low foot traffic, good mobile signal

locationFields.label: Why this location works
locationFields.value: Natural, calm, away from the city — suits the mindset for this work

locationFields.label: By train
locationFields.value: Belgrave line from Flinders Street — terminus is Belgrave Station. Walk or short taxi to the park.

locationFields.label: By car
locationFields.value: Monash Freeway east, exit at Belgrave. Parking available near the park area.

locationFields.label: Travel notes
locationFields.value: Check mobile coverage before committing (Telstra tends to be strongest in the ranges). Arrive 10 min early to settle before the first call.

amenities.label: Cafes
amenities.value: Several cafes on Belgrave's main strip — good for a pre-session coffee

amenities.label: Shops
amenities.value: Small supermarket for any last-minute supplies

amenities.label: Shelter
amenities.value: Covered picnic areas in the park if weather turns
